"""
Project Title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model for CIFAR-10 Image Generation (ai-ml-ds-DDPMCIFAR2025)
File Name: denoising_diffusion_cifar10.py

Short Description:
Implements a DDPM in Keras for unconditional CIFAR-10 image synthesis.
Includes noise schedule, UNet backbone, training loop, and sampling procedure with multiple example use cases.
"""

import os  # type: ignore
import datetime  # type: ignore
import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import tensorflow as tf  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model, Input  # type: ignore
import tensorflow_datasets as tfds  # type: ignore

# =========================
# 1. Hyperparameters
# =========================
IMG_SHAPE: tuple = (32, 32, 3)
BATCH_SIZE: int = 128
EPOCHS: int = 200
LR: float = 1e-4
TIMESTEPS: int = 1000
BETA_START: float = 1e-4
BETA_END: float = 0.02
SAVE_DIR: str = "./ddpm_cifar10/" + datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
os.makedirs(SAVE_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# =========================
# 2. Noise schedule
# =========================
beta: np.ndarray = np.linspace(BETA_START, BETA_END, TIMESTEPS, dtype=np.float32)  # type: np.ndarray
alpha: np.ndarray = 1.0 - beta  # type: np.ndarray
alpha_bar: np.ndarray = np.cumprod(alpha, axis=0)  # type: np.ndarray

# =========================
# 3. Data loading
# =========================
def preprocess(example: dict) -> tf.Tensor:
    img: tf.Tensor = tf.cast(example["image"], tf.float32) / 127.5 - 1.0  # type: tf.Tensor
    return tf.image.resize(img, IMG_SHAPE[:2])

ds_train = tfds.load("cifar10", split="train", shuffle_files=True)
ds_train = ds_train.map(preprocess, num_parallel_calls=tf.data.AUTOTUNE)
ds_train = ds_train.shuffle(10000).batch(BATCH_SIZE).prefetch(tf.data.AUTOTUNE)

# =========================
# 4. UNet backbone
# =========================
def build_unet() -> Model:
    inp_x: Input = Input(shape=IMG_SHAPE, name="img")
    inp_t: Input = Input(shape=(1,), name="time")

    # Time embedding
    t_emb: tf.Tensor = layers.Dense(128, activation="relu")(inp_t)
    t_emb = layers.Dense(np.prod(IMG_SHAPE))(t_emb)
    t_emb = layers.Reshape(IMG_SHAPE)(t_emb)

    x: tf.Tensor = inp_x
    # Down
    d1 = layers.Conv2D(64, 3, padding="same", activation="swish")(x)
    d1 = layers.Conv2D(64, 3, padding="same", activation="swish")(d1)
    p1 = layers.MaxPooling2D()(d1)

    d2 = layers.Conv2D(128, 3, padding="same", activation="swish")(p1)
    d2 = layers.Conv2D(128, 3, padding="same", activation="swish")(d2)
    p2 = layers.MaxPooling2D()(d2)

    d3 = layers.Conv2D(256, 3, padding="same", activation="swish")(p2)
    d3 = layers.Conv2D(256, 3, padding="same", activation="swish")(d3)

    # Up
    u2 = layers.UpSampling2D()(d3)
    u2 = layers.Concatenate()([u2, d2])
    u2 = layers.Conv2D(128, 3, padding="same", activation="swish")(u2)
    u2 = layers.Conv2D(128, 3, padding="same", activation="swish")(u2)

    u1 = layers.UpSampling2D()(u2)
    u1 = layers.Concatenate()([u1, d1])
    u1 = layers.Conv2D(64, 3, padding="same", activation="swish")(u1)
    u1 = layers.Conv2D(64, 3, padding="same", activation="swish")(u1)

    # Add time embedding
    h: tf.Tensor = layers.Add()([u1, t_emb])

    out: tf.Tensor = layers.Conv2D(3, 1, padding="same")(h)
    return Model(inputs=[inp_x, inp_t], outputs=out, name="Unet")

unet: Model = build_unet()
optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LR)

# =========================
# 5. Training step
# =========================
@tf.function
def train_step(x0: tf.Tensor):
    batch: int = tf.shape(x0)[0]
    t: tf.Tensor = tf.random.uniform((batch,1), 0, TIMESTEPS, dtype=tf.int32)  # type: tf.Tensor
    t_f: tf.Tensor = tf.cast(t, tf.int32)

    alpha_bar_t = tf.gather(alpha_bar, t_f)[:,None,None,None]
    noise = tf.random.normal(tf.shape(x0))
    xt = tf.sqrt(alpha_bar_t) * x0 + tf.sqrt(1 - alpha_bar_t) * noise

    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        pred_noise = unet([xt, tf.cast(t, tf.float32)], training=True)
        loss = tf.reduce_mean((noise - pred_noise)**2)
    grads = tape.gradient(loss, unet.trainable_variables)
    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(grads, unet.trainable_variables))
    return loss

# =========================
# 6. Training loop
# =========================
for epoch in range(1, EPOCHS+1):
    for x_batch in ds_train:
        loss = train_step(x_batch)
    if epoch % 50 == 0:
        tf.print(f"Epoch {epoch}/{EPOCHS} Loss: {loss:.4f}")

# =========================
# 7. Sampling (inference)
# =========================
def sample(n: int = 16):
    img = tf.random.normal((n, *IMG_SHAPE))
    for i in reversed(range(TIMESTEPS)):
        t = tf.fill((n,1), i)
        pred_noise = unet([img, tf.cast(t, tf.float32)], training=False)
        beta_t = beta[i]
        alpha_t = alpha[i]
        alpha_bar_t = alpha_bar[i]
        img = (1/np.sqrt(alpha_t))*(img - ((beta_t/np.sqrt(1-alpha_bar_t))*pred_noise))
        if i>0:
            img += tf.sqrt(beta_t) * tf.random.normal(tf.shape(img))
    return tf.clip_by_value((img+1)/2, 0, 1)

# =========================
# 8. Example use cases
# =========================
# Use case 1: Generate and save a grid of 16 samples
samples: tf.Tensor = sample(16)
tf.io.write_file(os.path.join(SAVE_DIR,"samples.png"),
    tf.image.encode_png(tf.image.convert_image_dtype(
        tf.concat(tf.split(samples,4,0),2), tf.uint8)))

# Use case 2: Generate single image
single: tf.Tensor = sample(1)
tf.io.write_file(os.path.join(SAVE_DIR,"single.png"),
    tf.image.encode_png(tf.image.convert_image_dtype(single[0], tf.uint8)))
